ios.desc:
Point your camera at a landmark, a dish, a wildflower or a sign you can't read, and Spotter tells you what you're looking at. Every photo you take is saved as a Spot in your travel journal.

HOW IT WORKS
Take a photo. Spotter identifies the subject and writes a short synopsis in a few seconds. Premium adds three more ways to read the same subject, Timeline, Deep Dive and Verdict, plus a chat for follow-up questions.

WHAT YOU CAN POINT IT AT
• Street food and dishes you don't recognize, so you know what you're ordering
• Wildlife, plants and flowers you pass on a trail
• Menus, signs and notices in a language you don't read
• Monuments, museums and buildings, and the history behind them

YOUR TRAVEL JOURNAL
Every identification is saved with the photo, the location and the date. Your Spots sit on a timeline you can scroll back through later.

FREE
• Unlimited photo identifications
• A Quick Facts synopsis on every Spot
• Your 5 most recent Spots, with photos and locations
• Syncing across your devices

SPOTTER PREMIUM
• Your full journal history, and search across all of it
• Chat with the AI about any Spot
• Three more synopsis styles: Timeline, Deep Dive and Verdict
• Custom synopsis modes you write yourself
• A choice of AI model (Gemini or GPT)
• $6.99 per month or $39.99 per year

Every new account starts with a free week of Premium. No payment details
needed.

Spotter needs a free account so your Spots sync and survive a new phone.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. You can manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://the-slop-shop.github.io/spotter-site/privacy/
